description: Fix layout header visibility and i18n import issues. The sticky header from layout.tsx appears on landing and auth pages which have their own full-screen gradient headers, causing visual clutter. The landing page also imports i18n from wrong path ('../i18n' instead of '@/i18n').
steps: 1. In frontend/app/layout.tsx: Import usePathname from 'next/navigation' and wrap header in conditional: only render when pathname !== '/' and pathname !== '/auth'. This hides the global header on landing and auth pages.
2. In frontend/app/page.tsx line 15: Change import from '../i18n' to '@/i18n' to use the path alias defined in tsconfig.json.
3. In frontend/app/page.tsx line 77: Change dynamic import from '../i18n' to '@/i18n'.
4. Test by navigating to / (landing) and /auth - global header should NOT appear. Navigate to /onboarding, /results, /document - global header SHOULD appear.
acceptance_criteria: Landing page (/) shows no white sticky header at top - only the gradient header with logo
Auth page (/auth) shows no white sticky header - only the gradient header
Onboarding, results, and document pages show the white sticky header with ArthSathi logo and language switcher
npm run build completes without TypeScript errors about i18n imports
verification: cd frontend && npm run build - should complete successfully
npm run dev and visit http://localhost:3000 - header should not appear
